title: Network surge notice
description: A notice from the 988 network administrator to centers that contact volumes are rising nationally or in a region and what backup capacity is doing. States numbers and the time of issue; makes no promise of backup answer times. Never includes method detail or a real helpline number outside the exercise marking. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

summary.description: Plain statement of the surge and its likely cause (a news event), with the volume change against the same hour last week
examples: Offered texts and chats in the Midwest are 2.1 times the same hour last week after a widely reported community tragedy. Calls are 1.6 times.
Report staffing shortfalls through the state coordinator.
Keep outbound work paused until further notice.

reroutingNote.description: A reminder of rerouting timers with their date
examples: As of March 2026: unanswered calls reroute to backup after about 2 minutes, texts and chats after about 5 minutes, and Spanish-language contacts cannot be rerouted.
